records.formula: omega = 2 s u / A, A = (u^2 + s^2)^2 - Delta s^2 sin^2 theta, Delta = u^2 - 2u + s^2
records.source: Bardeen 1970, ApJ 162, 71 (locally non-rotating frame); BPT72 section III eqs. 3.1-3.3

records.formula: N = sqrt(Delta Sigma / A), Sigma = u^2 + s^2 cos^2 theta
records.source: Bardeen 1973 (3+1 lapse N = sqrt(Delta Sigma / A))

records.formula: v_Z = (Omega - omega) h / N, h = sqrt(A/Sigma) sin(theta), Omega = k/(u^(3/2) + k s)
records.source: BPT72 section II (circular equatorial orbits)
